blockers.detail: Original sensor mounts retained; verify the optical-axis semantic correction and physical head/tail clearance. No hardware assembly pass implied.
480Hz implicit PhysX position/velocity drives with K=12000, D=600/1800; internal FR3 damping/controller response and FCI filtering not replicated.
120Hz exact zero-latency workpiece pose, individual pad contacts and fixture impulses; no real sensor/calibration/latency model. Alignment gate is 25um.
Robot gravity disabled in PhysX; real FR3 gravity compensation exists but motor torque/load calibration and contact torque budget remain unverified.
Robotiq 2F-85 direct joint motor/mimic model is not the real position/speed/force register interface; command latency, force/position resolution and compliance not calibrated.
Added clamp jaws, 80ms closure ramp, pin supply sleeve and spring button are assumed; no measured mechanical stroke, response, placement or PLC I/O.
No executed 1kHz libfranka loop, network jitter test, robot-specific limits, collision thresholds or measured torque-rate trace.
One deterministic episode; no tolerance, friction, perception-noise or delay robustness distribution; cycle omits ready-pose initialization and return to start.
Imported-model screening exceeds 1000 Nm/s; not measured robot torque.
